summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes large obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods the binary in a temp directory, and then invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` at `npm install` time. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated payload using string-array rotation and hex-named identifiers, with no source, build artifacts, or connection to the package's stated purpose as a React micro-frontend loader. Executing a bundled obfuscated script under a freshly downloaded alternate language runtime is an alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that evades Node-focused scanners and runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine at install time. The package is published under the `@servicetitan/*` public npm scope with a peer dependency on `@servicetitan/web-components`, matching a dependency-confusion shape targeting ServiceTitan build environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
